Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We have reviewed your offer and the supporting cost breakdown. We recognise that larger adjustments require management approval and ask you to revise the offer within your delegated authority, using the stated cost drivers as the basis and focusing on a later effective date and extended payment terms.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 356.33 per unit, 90 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,177,176 over the term.
3. Basis: Our demand forecast for this part is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09), and we commit 6,110 units a year. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). On quality: we raised 2 quality notifications on this part in the last 12 months, at 4,632 ppm on average (qn:20004698, qn:20004826).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

The quality record figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. We request further proof regarding the quality notifications, as the figures you provided contradict our internal records.

CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.

We have incorporated the verified volume increase and the PPI-C241 index change into our revised calculation. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We cannot accommodate the 90-day payment term without a price increase; we therefore propose returning to 30 days net to offer a reduced unit price of EUR 369.76. As an alternative at our standard terms, we offer a price of €369.76 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
